name: partner-bike-goal-side-job
description: A shared distance goal on the bike; whoever is off the bike does a set, swap after each set.
rawText:
TEAM OF 2
For time (40 min cap):
20 km Echo Bike as a team
One partner rides while the other does:
10 Wall Balls 9/6kg
10 Burpees
Switch after each set
